newsitem.title: USA: Ford studying whether to close European plants.
newsitem.headline: Ford studying whether to close European plants.

text.p: Ford Motor Co is considering whether to close any of its nine major vehicle assembly plants in Europe, having been recently surprised in the third quarter by losses in its European operations, The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.

Ford Chairman Alex Trotman confirmed previous reports by individuals close to the company that Ford is studying the possible closure of plants in North America as well, but he said no decisions have been made about factories on either continent, the story says.
Trotman said cost cutting in Europe is a "top priority" for 1997, the story says.
